grammar_definition:
root ::= expr_0
expr_0 ::= expr_1 ( ws bin_op ws expr_1 )?
expr_1 ::= expr_2 ( ws bin_op ws expr_2 )?
expr_2 ::= expr_3 ( ws bin_op ws expr_3 )?
expr_3 ::= atom ( "." member_call | "?" | ".await" )*
atom ::= ident ( "(" ( ws ident ( ws "," ws ident )* )? ws ")" )? | "(" ws expr_0 ws ")"
bin_op ::= "+" | "-" | "*" | "/" | "==" | "!=" | "&&" | "||"
member_call ::= [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]* ( "()" )?
ident ::= "db" | "find_user_by_email" | "req"
ws ::= [ \t\n\r]*
